scope: Replace the numerical representation and contraction/scale path of up, gate and down with integer DPE; preserve the public interface and BF16 nonlinear/epilogue boundaries.
whole_graph: BF16 normalized input -> 16-element block scale and two signed INT8 radix-128 digits -> replicated two-lane TRF -> exact FP4-to-2w INT8 conversion -> I8xI8 dot -> I32 128*hi+lo -> F32 scale restoration and weight block scale -> BF16 up/gate -> unchanged GeGLU -> same block quantization and integer contraction for down -> F32 column sum -> BF16 and unchanged epilogue
activation: For each 16-element block: s=2^floor(log2(max(amax,2^-120)))/64; hi=clip(round_half_away_from_zero(x/s),-127,127); lo=round_half_away_from_zero((x/s-hi)*128). Restore x approximately as (128*hi+lo)*s/128. Two digits chosen independently of E104's three E5M2 terms; numerical screening is required.
weight: FP4 E2M1 -> exact FP8 lookup -> F32 widening -> vector_fp_to_fxp(30), which represents 2*w -> INT8 cast. No host prepacking; all conversion costs remain inside the kernel.
integer_bound: For 16 elements, |dot_hi|<=16*127*12=24384, |dot_lo|<=16*64*12=12288, so |128*dot_hi+dot_lo|<=3133440 <2^24 and <2^31. F32 conversion is exact before scale restoration.
selected_components: E74 BF16 input contract, F32 block-scale reduction and BF16 nonlinear/epilogue boundaries
C07 two-lane term layout/unzip mechanism, with integer radix coefficients and I32 arithmetic instead of FP8 approximation
C04 ring broadcast mechanism for redistributed down inputs
removed_assumptions: BF16 weight lookup immediately before each dot
E104 global activation scale and three floating-point residual terms
Existing block dot dtype and scale-restoration placement
prior_related: C07 native FP8 and scale-contraction variants; integer operands, I32 radix combination and per-block activation quantization were not tested there
C14-A whole-FFN producer/consumer pipeline failed padding redistribution; that mapping is not inherited
first_gate: Independent arithmetic/range checks, then a small diagnostic compiling exact FP4 conversion and two-lane INT8 dot/I32 radix combination. This probe is not a competition submission or evidence of whole-FFN performance.
stop_condition: One primitive prototype and at most one clear API/shape correction. If unsupported or numerical/cost evidence removes the benefit, close with source and logs. If viable, implement the declared complete three-projection FFN and screen it, with one clear compile correction at most; do not substitute a local E104 edit for this architecture.
promotion: Whole-kernel correctness and contemporary E104 control on Arena required; static primitive timings do not establish speedup. Default <5% target-kernel gain closes tuning after bounded validation.

reopening.reason: User challenged closure before compilation/performance evaluation. v2 is our padded scalar gather layout error, not evidence that INT8 FFN is unsupported or unpromising.
reopening.specific_repair: Before scale DMA, transpose four scalar time steps into a contiguous 4-F32 (16-byte) packet and trim padding. Both H and L quantizers use this producer layout; canonical scale vectors and dot consumers retain the original block indexing.
reopening.scope: Same C13 architecture, no changed arithmetic or parameter search. Follow concrete implementation failures to an executable full kernel; retain every attempt and reassess if an actual unsupported operation or cost/accuracy failure is established.

correction.cause: An explicit anonymous 1#4 does not survive fetch-sequencer normalization; v5 panics on the identical 64-vs-256 partition.
correction.fix: Run the H quantizer on four named identical input copies (4*60 active slices, physical 4*64). After quantization, reinterpret redundant copy groups as inactive padding and transfer copy 0. The L quantizer already has 240 active slices. This changes physical activation preparation work, not the two-digit arithmetic or projection contract.
correction.invariant: All QuantCopies receive the same BF16 input through typed broadcast, execute identical arithmetic and have identical digits/restoration scales before discarding redundant copies.
